text: Apron is a minimal protocol for self-hosted chats. Simple enough to write a server in ~100 lines, powerful enough for rooms, threads, bots, reactions, and more. For agents: apron.chat/llms.txt links the spec in Markdown, the servers, clients, JSON Schema and wire fixtures to test against. JSON over any transport, like WebSocket. Tiny core and optional incremental capabilities with graceful fallbacks.
